name: Open WebUI
description: Self-hosted chat interface for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs: multi-user, RAG document upload, model presets, chat history.
compose:
services:
  open-webui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8080"
    environment:
      OLLAMA_BASE_URL: "${{cfg.ollama_url}}"
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/backend/data
    restart: unless-stopped
